name: claude-code-interactive
description: Control local Claude Code interactive CLI sessions from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Claude Code CLI sessions from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Starts Claude Code in an isolated tmux PTY and lets Codex send prompts, press approval keys, read the screen, and stop sessions.
defaultPrompt: Start Claude Code in this project and ask it to review the current changes.
Open a Claude Code plan session for this task.
